import pandas as pd
trips = tables['trips']
tides = tables['tides']

# weekday of fish_date_t (t is days on timeline, integer floor -> weekday via mod, but we don't know epoch alignment)
# instead use schedule/trips fish_date_t modulo 7 as proxy for weekday cycle
trips2 = trips.copy()
trips2['wd'] = (trips2.fish_date_t.astype(int)) % 7

# Focus on DAY_1_5 and OVERNIGHT in Apr(doy91-120) and Oct(doy274-304)
mask_apr = trips2.fish_date_doy.between(91,120)
mask_oct = trips2.fish_date_doy.between(274,304)
sub = trips2[(mask_apr|mask_oct) & trips2.cls.isin(['day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter'])]
g1 = sub.groupby(['cls','wd']).apply(lambda d: pd.Series({'yt_per_angler': d.yt.sum()/d.anglers.sum(), 'n': len(d)}))

# tide swing merge: join trips fish_date to tides target_date by season+doy
tj = trips2.merge(tides, left_on=['fish_date_season','fish_date_doy'], right_on=['target_date_season','target_date_doy'], how='inner')
tj['swing'] = tj.tide_high_ft - tj.tide_low_ft
tj_hd = tj[tj.cls.isin(['hd_am','hd_pm','three_quarter'])]
import numpy as np
corr = tj_hd[['swing']].assign(yt_rate=tj_hd.yt/tj_hd.anglers.replace(0,np.nan))['yt_rate'].corr(tj_hd['swing'])

# bucket by swing tercile
tj_hd = tj_hd.dropna(subset=['swing'])
tj_hd['swing_bucket'] = pd.qcut(tj_hd.swing, 3, labels=['low','mid','high'])
g2 = tj_hd.groupby('swing_bucket').apply(lambda d: pd.Series({'yt_per_angler': d.yt.sum()/d.anglers.sum(),'n':len(d)}))

# climate ONI over the season
clim = tables['climate']
oni = clim[clim.index_id=='oni'].sort_values('avail_t')[['avail_doy','value']]

result = {'weekday_table': g1.reset_index(), 'tide_swing_corr': corr, 'swing_bucket_table': g2.reset_index(), 'oni_tail': oni.tail(12)}
